Package info.openrocket.core.simulation

Class FlightData

java.lang.Object
info.openrocket.core.simulation.FlightData
public class FlightData extends Object
A collection of various flight data. This is the result of a simulation, or importing data into the software. The data includes:
  • A number of generally interesting values of a simulation, such as max. altitude and velocity
  • A number (or zero) of flight data branches containing the actual data
  • A WarningSet including warnings that occurred during simulation

A FlightData object can be made immutable by calling immute().

  • Constructor Details

    • FlightData

      public FlightData()
      Create a FlightData object with no content. The resulting object is mutable.

    • FlightData

      public FlightData(double maxAltitude, double maxVelocity, double maxAcceleration, double maxMachNumber, double timeToApogee, double flightTime, double groundHitVelocity, double launchRodVelocity, double deploymentVelocity, double optimumDelay)
      Construct a FlightData object with no data branches but the specified summary information. The resulting object is mutable.
      Parameters:
      maxAltitude - maximum altitude.
      maxVelocity - maximum velocity.
      maxAcceleration - maximum acceleration.
      maxMachNumber - maximum Mach number.
      timeToApogee - time to apogee.
      flightTime - total flight time.
      groundHitVelocity - ground hit velocity.
      launchRodVelocity - velocity at launch rod clearance
      deploymentVelocity - velocity at deployment
      optimumDelay - optimum motor ejection delay time

      public info.openrocket.core.logging.WarningSet getWarningSet()

      the warnings generated during this simulation.
